channel.title: Signal — Afrodescendant Ali
channel.description: Published stories from Afrodescendant Ali’s Signal desk across the Black World.

item.title: Security operations reported across several areas in Haiti
item.description: AP, UN/BINUH and local reporting describe operations and violence in different parts of the country; the accounts are not merged into a single measure of success.

item.title: ECLAC records at least 3,386 femicides across 27 countries and territories
item.description: The regional observatory’s official 2025 measure separates recorded femicides from attempted or frustrated cases and does not support the conflicting 24-per-day claim.

item.title: Canary Islands declares emergency as maritime arrivals strain El Hierro
item.description: The Canary Islands government declared a health, social and security emergency on El Hierro; reporting describes maritime arrivals without assigning nationality, intent or legal status.

item.title: Gambia receives roadmap for national decarbonisation toward 2063
item.description: An AU-backed roadmap sets out long-term emissions and renewable-energy targets for The Gambia; implementation and financing remain the test.

item.title: UN report documents 1,167 killings in Haiti in third quarter
item.description: A BINUH report covering 1 July–30 September records 1,167 people killed and 459 injured amid gang attacks, security operations and self-defence incidents.

item.title: Sheriff elections put local immigration agreements in focus
item.description: An AP review of roughly 250 sheriff races examined where 287(g) agreements featured in campaigns; official and local results show the issue’s local political stakes.

item.title: Analysis: Southern organizers are building a longer Black political bench
item.description: Across Georgia, Tennessee, South Carolina and Mississippi, organizers are trying to connect voter registration to candidate recruitment and durable local power.

item.title: Brazil data shows income gap among Black women reporting violence
item.description: A data update reported by Agência Brasil says 73% of Black women reporting domestic or family violence lived in households earning up to two minimum wages, compared with 54% of white women.

item.title: French court recognizes racist nature of violence in Michel Zecler case
item.description: Three officers received prison sentences in the case arising from the 2020 beating of the Black music producer; the court’s reasoning remains the key legal record.

item.title: Mauritius hosts Indian Ocean regional health forum
item.description: The 22nd colloquium on HIV, hepatitis and addictions brought regional health stakeholders together in Quatre-Bornes from 18 to 20 November.
